comment: R-approved corrections applied by compile_mocks.py on top of the approved packs' values JSON. Owner rule (R, 2026-10-07): where an approved mock's images and its values JSON disagree, the images win; P3 samples the images and records the correction here. Original pack values are kept for history.

corrections.reason: The pack's sky gradient (#73A5CC zenith, #A2C4DC at 30°, #DBDCD1 horizon) is paler and greyer than its own four hero paint-overs; built exactly, the engine sky read pale grey-blue (5A finding, 7 Oct).
corrections.method: Sampled the four approved mid-afternoon heroes (images/lakeview-hero.png, denver-hero.png, wilmette-hero.png, postcard-hero.png; 1672x941). Row elevation from the paint-overs' source camera (vFOV 50°, pitch down 3°). Sky pixels: b > r+40, b > g+10, b > 170, r+g+b > 420 (excludes blue windows). Bands: top 17-22° (frame top), mid 8-14°, horizon = the lowest 5 % of rows with visible sky (median 6.4°; below that houses and trees hide the sky). Clouds: near-white pixels above 3° (lit r+g+b > 705, shade otherwise). Per-image channel median, then the median across the four images (cloud lit from 2 images with enough lit pixels; mid from 3, Denver shows no sky at 8-14°). Every 3rd column, every 2nd row. No zenith is visible in any hero: the top-band colour is held from 20° to 90°.
